requirements.text: Users should receive real-time notifications for every transaction, including the amount spent, the merchant or location, and the updated account balance.
The app should provide an easily accessible 'Freeze Card' button, allowing users to freeze or unfreeze their card with a single tap and a confirmation action.
Users should be able to set monthly spending limits for various categories (e.g., groceries, dining out) and receive alerts when approaching or exceeding those limits.
The app must maintain a modern and user-friendly interface similar to fintech competitors like Revolut, facilitating a smooth user experience.
Budgeting tools should be integrated into the app to help users manage their finances effectively, with features that allow for tracking spending and setting financial goals.
